newsitem.headline: American Annuity Group Q3 oper shr $0.38.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTES: Net income including realized investment gains and nonrecurring items was $15.4 million or $0.35 per share for the third quarter 1996, compared to $16.6 million or $0.41 per share for third quarter 1995.
Third quarter 1995 oper net excludes gains of $4.5 million from realized investment, vs $300,000 in the third quarter 1996.

Net income figures for the third quarter and first nine months of 1996 also exclude extraordinary losses from the retirement of debt of $1.7 million or $0.04 per share and $6 million or $0.14 per share, respectively.
American Annuity issued 3.9 million common shares in a rights offering in August 1995.
